title: Plan L: AI Podcast Production Workflow
summary: Topic & positioning → script & outline → record/TTS → AI edit → audio polish & music → publish & distribute
scenario: Best for anyone starting a podcast, knowledge product or branded audio — from topic to a listenable episode.

steps.title: Topic and positioning
steps.detail: Define the audience, theme, episode length and cadence; brainstorm topics with an LLM and study 1-2 reference podcasts for structure and pacing.
steps.tips: Decide 'what problem this episode solves for the listener' first; niche beats generic for building an audience.

steps.title: Script and outline
steps.detail: For interviews write question lists plus guest background; for solo shows write a segmented outline (hook → expansion → action). Give the model your style and revise its first pass.
steps.tips: Putting your 3-5 core questions in the outline makes the conversation more natural than a verbatim script.

steps.title: Record or TTS
steps.detail: With guests, record locally on each side for audio quality; solo, record live or use AI voice. For AI voice use ElevenLabs/MiniMax Chinese voices and audition a few before choosing.
steps.tips: For AI dubbing keep sentences short with punctuation; test-record one segment first.

steps.title: AI editing
steps.detail: Edit on a text timeline (Descript): delete filler, pauses and repeats by deleting words; fix slip-ups with Overdub. CapCut for segmenting and basic edits.
steps.tips: 'Edit the text, not the waveform' keeps the feel of speech; listen to deleted spans to confirm the context still flows.

steps.title: Audio polish and music
steps.detail: One-click denoise and de-reverb (Adobe Podcast/Auphonic); normalize loudness to podcast standard (~-16 LUFS); add intro/outro BGM kept low.
steps.tips: Consistent loudness reads more 'professional' than raw sound quality; keep BGM under 30% of voice.

steps.title: Publish and distribute
steps.detail: Create cover art, shownotes (AI-generated summary + timestamps + links) and RSS; publish to XiaoYuzhou, Apple Podcasts and Spotify; build a collection page.
steps.tips: Timestamps in shownotes let listeners jump straight to what they want — higher completion rate.

pitfalls.title: Poor audio quality
pitfalls.detail: Recording in a noisy room is the cardinal sin; quiet room + close mic, with AI denoise as a safety net.

pitfalls.title: Unedited filler
pitfalls.detail: Text-based editing cuts filler in minutes; too much dead air loses listeners.

pitfalls.title: Empty shownotes
pitfalls.detail: Blank shownotes waste SEO and sharing; use AI for summary, timestamps and links.

pitfalls.title: Robotic AI voice
pitfalls.detail: Long stretches of pure TTS tire the ear; punctuation, emotion tags and voice choice all help.
